outcomes.message: No pain or unusual-symptom concern was reported in this check. That does not determine that training is safe.
limitations: Marathoner cannot assess symptoms or confirm that activity is safe.
Stop and seek appropriate help if pain or unusual symptoms appear or worsen.

outcomes.message: Stop the workout and call 911 now. Do not wait for Marathoner to assess the symptom or resume training.
limitations: This draft is not a complete emergency checklist and cannot decide whether a symptom is safe.
Do not delay emergency help while using Marathoner.

outcomes.message: Stop the workout and seek advice from a qualified health care professional before resuming training.
limitations: Marathoner cannot diagnose the cause or severity of pain or unusual symptoms.
A race date or planned progression does not override this stop-and-seek-help result.

outcomes.message: Marathoner does not have enough information to make a training recommendation. Review the concern outside the app before relying on new training advice.
limitations: Missing or ambiguous information never implies that training is safe.
Use emergency services for urgent warning signs and qualified care for other concerning or persistent symptoms.
